task.title: Connect Client Devices
task.shortdesc: Configure a client device to receive the network settings from the or to use manually assigned network settings.

prereq.p: Before you configure a client device, make sure that:

ul.li: The is turned on and connected to the Internet.
The client device is connected to the through Ethernet or Wi-Fi.
You have administrator access to the client device.
You have the required IP address, subnet mask, gateway address, and DNS server address if you want to use manual network settings.

context.p: A client device requires valid network settings to communicate with other devices and access the Internet. By default, the automatically assigns these settings to connected devices.
context.note: Use automatic network settings unless the network administrator instructs you to use manual settings.
A manually assigned IP address must be unique. Do not assign anaddress that is in use by another device.

step.cmd: Open the network settings on the client device.

info.p: The name and location of the network settings depend on the device and operating system.

step.cmd: Select the active Ethernet or Wi-Fi connection.

info.p: The IP configuration can be identified as IP settings, TCP/IP, or Internet Protocol Version 4.

choices.choice: Select automatic configuration to receive network settings from the .
Select manual configuration to assign specific settings.

step.cmd: Enable automatic IP address and DNS assignment.

info.p: The assigns the required network settings to the client device.

substep.cmd: Enter an available IP address in the applicable address range.

info.note: Do not assign if that address is already assigned to another device.

info.p: The client device can temporarily disconnect while it applies the settings.

step.cmd: Reconnect the client device to the network if necessary.

info.p: For a wireless device, select and enter the configured .

step.cmd: Verify the network settings on the client device.

info.p: Confirm that the device has an IP address, a default gateway, and a DNS server address.
For automatic configuration, confirm that the assigned IP address is in the .

step.stepresult: The client device can access the local network and Internet services.

result.p: The client device has valid network settings and can communicate with the .

postreq.p: Repeat this task for each client device that requires network configuration.
If the device cannot access the network, see .
